# G10 differences for the curve PCA

Share and loading numbers are historical examples (sample and date given); recompute on current data. Method in [SKILL.md](../SKILL.md).

| Market | What the sources show | Practical consequence |
|---|---|---|
| USD | SOFR swaps: PC1/PC2/PC3 = 88.34%/10.71%/0.73%; PC1 humped (0.279 at 2y, 0.334 at 7y, 0.272 at 50y); loadings unstable through 2020-22 ZIRP (internal research note, 2026). LIBOR swaps 2020-21: level 91.3%, slope 7.8%, short-rate 0.8% (Tuckman & Serrat, 2022). Pre-GFC PC1 hump peaked near 5y because the Fed pegged the very front; in 2020-21 level was weak at 1-7y. One factor suffices at 8-10y; 2 at 3-6y and the long end; 3 at the front. | DV01-neutral leaves level residue; fit LIBOR/SOFR via a stitched or fitted curve (histories break at LIBOR to SOFR and around the SRF); exclude ZLB from vol/macro regressions (calibrate pre-2008 spliced with the current regime). Fed on hold suppresses front-end PC1 loading (BofA, 2 May 2022). |
| EUR | Forwards on a 1y window: PC1 > 80%, PC2 10.1%, PC3 4.3% (Credit Suisse, 24 Oct 2012). ING reports one factor explains 97-99% of EUR curve variance depending on window (ING, 15 Jan 2020). Bund PC1 peaks at 5y; 2y PC1 entry was as high as 5y in 1993-97 (Huggins & Schaller, 2024). Euribor PCs have the USD shape but lower vol (level about 2.5bp/day vs over 3.5) (Tuckman & Serrat, 2022). PC1 response of EUR forwards is a barbell (JPM, 30 May 2024). | Use non-overlapping forwards; Euribor futures show more PCA inefficiencies than 1y forward swaps, limit to 1st-16th contract (ING, 3 Mar 2020). PC1-neutral fly can be convex around spot 7y near 0%. Long end (20y+, 25-35y) is flow/regulation-driven (Dutch FTK II in 2012; 25-35y flow in Mar 2020): residuals may not revert. EGB panels: PCA on 2/5/10/30y with PC3 excluded; spread panels use BFV curves, 25y rather than 30y (BofA, 21 Mar 2018). |
| GBP | GBP swap 1y-60y daily-difference PCA: first 3 PCs about 97% (2y sample) (QF Stack Exchange, PCA for risk bucketing, Feb 2019). GBP LIBOR PCs very similar to USD, USD slope more volatile (Tuckman & Serrat, 2022). 1y1y PC1 beta rose most this cycle (about 29 per 1 sd over 5y) (JPM, 30 May 2024). | EUR-GBP spread-forward PCA flagged 30y10y vs 40y10y (Credit Suisse, 2012). Gilt DV01 ladder (about 55 bonds) mapped to 5/10/30y buckets by PCA or regression Jacobian (QF Stack Exchange, Mar 2021). Pension/LDI flows distort long end; check before trading a residual. |
| JPY | PC1 response mostly at the long end (0y1y about 0.6 to 15y1y about 8) because of YCC and its unwind; lowest 1y1y fit R^2 (0.512) (JPM, 30 May 2024). Risk-free (yield - CDS) PCA effect also appears for JGBs but smaller (Huggins & Schaller, 2024). | Regime-split around YCC changes; PCA residuals on 10y10y/20y10y flatteners are a practitioner theme (trader chat, 21 Jan 2026) but verify DV01/gamma; JPY CPI-rates correlation (0.5) too weak for PC1-to-CPI trades. |
| CAD | BoC has the highest positive loading on the "follow the Fed" PC2 (about +0.22) (JPM, 30 May 2024). | Cross-market PCA residuals vs USD are relevant; test for loading stability. |
| AUD / NZD | RBA tracks PC1 closely; RBNZ has a strongly negative PC2 loading (about -0.8) and its PC2 beta flipped from about -50 long-run to about +55 over the last 10y (JPM, 30 May 2024). AUD and NZD load about 0.54 on the USD-anchored PC1 bloc in Asia 5y5y (Citi, 13 Aug 2026). | Short samples and policy divergence flip betas: use rolling or sub-period fits. |
| CHF / SEK / NOK | SNB leaned against the Fed via EUR/CHF management (PC2 about -0.35); SEK 1y1y-3y1y screened richest to USD (about -105 to -115bp); NOK 1y1y PC1 beta rose sharply (JPM, 30 May 2024). | Small, illiquid curves show less structure in higher eigenvectors (Düring, 2021): use k = 2, wider cost hurdle, and cross-market residuals against EUR or USD. |

Cross-market invariants: factor structure is fairly invariant across markets (DE similar to US); less liquid curves show less structure in higher eigenvectors (Düring, 2021). Non-standard
policy (QE, PSPP, YCC, LSAPs) suppresses cross-market PC1 correlation and weakens the PC3-vol link (Düring, 2021). Check `fi-g10-market-conventions` for curve ids, tenor grids and day counts.
